description: PORTLAND, OR – Today, Governor Tina Kotek announced she’s participating in debates and forums across Portland, Eugene, Medford and Bend to share how she’s continuing to tackle the biggest issues facing Oregon and how she’s fighting back against Donald Trump’s attacks directly with voters. Meanwhile, extremist Christine Drazan is refusing to face voters at a Portland debate […]
